name: raycast-agent-orchestration
description: Raycast agent orchestration system for chat-tree branching, git worktrees, subagents, local inference

scripts.worklog:agent:install: mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents" && cp launchd/com.pv.raycast-agent.worklog.plist "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/" && launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.pv.raycast-agent.worklog 2>/dev/null || true && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.pv.raycast-agent.worklog.plist"
scripts.watchdog:install: mkdir -p \"$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents\" && cp launchd/com.pv.raycast-agent.watchdog.plist \"$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/\" && launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.pv.raycast-agent.watchdog 2>/dev/null || true && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) \"$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.pv.raycast-agent.watchdog.plist\"
